## @umber-style/cache@0.1.0

First release. The cache that server-rendering setups make and pass around: the engine's cache, keyed by `key`, with the members that an app's setup reads and wraps.
([#48](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/issues/48))

### Added

- **`createCache({ key })`** (the default export): the cache of `@umber-style/core` with `key` as its prefix, and `key`, `compat`, `inserted`, `registered`, `sheet.tags` and `insert`. The engine calls `insert` for every group of rules it writes (a class, theme variables, global rules, `@keyframes` and `@property` rules, the layer order), so that a function put in its place sees each new rule once and can read its CSS from `inserted` when `compat` is set.
  [docs](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/blob/main/docs/cache-and-server.md)
- A cache made in the browser reads the `<style data-umber="<key> ...">` elements of the page and does not write their rules again.
- A set of global rules that a component rendered (`insertGlobal(set, { isRendered: true })`) is part of the CSS of the page that names it only; the server functions read that from the page.
- **`UmberCache`**: the type of the cache that `createCache` returns.
  [docs](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/blob/main/docs/typed-styles.md#the-type-names-apps-import)
- ESM and CommonJS builds with declarations.
- `UmberCache`, `SerializedRule` and `UmberSheet` are declared in `@umber-style/core` and re-exported here.
  ([#49](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/issues/49))
  [docs](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/blob/main/docs/cache-and-server.md)
- `sheet.tags` reads the document of the sheet the cache was given (an iframe's).
  ([#38](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/issues/38))
  [docs](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/blob/main/docs/cache-and-server.md)
- **`speedy`**, kept for compatibility with what an app passes to its cache: `true` writes the rules with `insertRule`, `false` as text nodes of the style element (`hasRuleText`, which wins when both are given). Without either the rules are text outside production.
  ([#52](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/issues/52))
  [docs](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/blob/main/docs/cache-and-server.md#createcache)
- `createCache` throws a `TypeError` for an `onInsert` option, which the cache sets itself (it calls `insert`), rather than dropping it; and it passes `hasVendorPrefixes` and the other options of the engine's cache on.
  ([#52](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/issues/52))
  [docs](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/blob/main/docs/cache-and-server.md#createcache)

### Packaging

- Depends on `@umber-style/core`, which is not bundled, so every package shares one engine.
